description: Create a new Incident Internal Note in OneUptime. Returns the created Incident Internal Note object with its ID. Use this to add new Incident Internal Notes to your project. Note: projectId is inferred from your API key — you do not need to provide it.

incidentId.description: Relation to Incident ID in which this resource belongs.

postedAt.description: Date and time the note belongs to in the timeline: when it was written, or - for a note saved from a Slack or Microsoft Teams message - when that message was posted.

postedFromSlackMessageId.description: Unique identifier for the Slack message this note was created from (channel_id:message_ts). Used to prevent duplicate notes when multiple users react to the same message.
postedFromSlackMessageId.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

projectId.description: ID of your OneUptime Project in which this object belongs.

name: create_incident_internal_note
title: Create Incident Internal Note
